scope: Offline recovery transactions (plan §11) stage v1 in the Rust agent: quota'd opaque artifact upload, validated prepare, and the full STAGED->VALIDATED->STOPPING->BACKED_UP->COMMITTING->STARTING->VERIFYING transaction with COMPENSATING rollback and startup compensation; unit tests plus an installed-runtime UDS E2E with real systemd on OrbStack

implementation.engine: src/recovery.rs: the uploaded artifact is an opaque controlled payload at this stage. upload() enforces staging quotas (<=32MiB per artifact, <=64MiB total, <=128 files, 0600, create-only ids); prepare() verifies the SHA256, requires the unit to be inside the explicit operator allowlist, and refuses while another transaction is active; execute() runs the plan §11.4 state machine — STOPPING (systemctl stop + confirmed inactive), BACKED_UP (file-level snapshot-directory backup with name/size/mode/sha256 manifest), COMMITTING (payload placed as snapshot_<max+1>.xml, new ids exceed every existing one), STARTING (systemctl start), VERIFYING (unit active + placed bytes hash-equal), then SUCCEEDED with a durable receipt. Any stage failure runs COMPENSATING: the placed candidate is removed only when it still hash-matches, backups are restored file-by-file, unknown post-backup files are removed, the unit is restarted; outcome is FAILED or RECOVERY_REQUIRED. A non-terminal journal at agent startup is compensated before the agent reports ready
implementation.gating: the entire feature is disabled unless AGENT_RECOVERY_UNITS is explicitly configured (bounded .service names); the snapshot directory defaults to /opt/eclipse/kura/user/snapshots and is overridable via AGENT_RECOVERY_SNAPSHOT_DIR; production stayed disabled at the end of the round
implementation.uds: local.rs recovery.status|upload|prepare|execute for the local admin peer (first-frame allowlist extended); typed errors INVALID_ARGUMENT/CONFLICT/FORBIDDEN/RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED/NOT_FOUND/INTERNAL

limits.artifactSemantics: the payload is opaque at this stage: no XML parsing/external-entity hardening, no encrypted-snapshot decryption, no Kura version/key verification, no field-level correction, and no factory-instance deletion semantics; a real Kura snapshot placed this way still needs those before production use
limits.verifyDepth: VERIFYING checks unit liveness and placed-bytes integrity only; Kura bridge/business health confirmation is future work
limits.consoleProtocolReact: no gRPC/HTTP/React surface yet; recovery is local-UDS admin only
limits.javaTool: no short-lived Java recovery tool; Kura XML/crypto reuse per plan §11.3 remains open
